profile.headline: Senior Staff Engineer at Google and Adjunct Associate Professor at University of Chicago
profile.summary:
TL in Search Infrastructure at Google since 2009. Most of my experience has been on backend-centric, distributed-systems heavy projects but more recently I've been responsible for creating full-stack, developer-facing platforms. Particular focus on Internet-scale performance, scalability, and building APIs for other internal developers to use to build the next generation of Google Search experiences. Spent several years as a TLM (managing a team of up to 12) but have returned to a senior IC role.

Along with my work at Google, I'm also an Adjunct Associate Professor of Computer Science at the University of Chicago, teaching part time in their professional masters program. I currently teach the Operating Systems and intro-level Networks courses.
